# Security Policy

## Reporting Vulnerabilities
Please do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Instead, use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-fixing-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability-to-an-owner) feature.

## Disclaimer
This repository is a Public Demo only. It does not contain the proprietary AI analysis engine, backend logic, or sensitive production code.
